description:
Create a new empty layer above the active layer.

Use when: user needs a blank layer for painting, fills, or stacking content.
Do NOT use when: adding text — use photoshop_create_text_layer.

Returns: created layer name and context.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds layer to history.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_create_layer
